title: Inflation Data Cools, Bullish S&P Chart Remains Strong, Top Trades For Jobs Report And MU Earnings!
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Every PCE reading came in below forecast, taking pressure off yields and giving stocks a bid, though 3.4% is still far above the Fed's 2% target.
The 10y pierced the 2007 high of 5.28% then pulled back, so he reads resistance as holding; lower yields would help stocks, gold, silver and Bitcoin.
Equal-weight S&P is 6% off highs vs <2% for the S&P; he sees this as bullish because laggards have room to bounce.
Micron earnings will be great but new fabs (2027-28) will compress memory margins.

calls.condition: Possible inverse head and shoulders: if it forms, targets 8,000 on the S&P; if the S&P breaks into his 'neutral zone' he turns neutral.
calls.reason: S&P still above its neutral zone and <2% from all-time highs; narrow breadth seen as bullish fuel; potential inverse H&S.
calls.quote: I continue to be net long the market.

calls.reason: Yield pierced the 2007 high (5.28%) at 5.29% and rejected; with cooler PCE he expects resistance to hold and yields to ease a little.
calls.quote: that tells me is that resistance as of now is still holding

calls.condition: If the ascending trend line breaks, oil retraces to the lower parallel trend line, below $80.
calls.reason: Fourth test of the ascending trend line makes a break more likely (50/50); expects a near-term pullback; not buying oil.
calls.quote: I'm still expecting a pullback in the near term to this trend line

calls.condition: If the pivot-low trend line holds, neutral to slightly bullish; if it breaks, likely 3,900 and possibly 3,500.
calls.reason: Third hit on a long trend line should bounce; break would turn him bearish near-term. Long-term bullish on fiscal irresponsibility; holds gold for decades.
calls.quote: am I bullish near-term, I'm neutral to maybe slightly... If you ask me if I'm bullish long-term, heck yeah.

calls.condition: If the trend line breaks, silver goes to 55 and potentially 50; if it holds, he gives it the benefit of the doubt.
calls.reason: Same trend-line setup as gold; long-term bullish on precious metals.
calls.quote: this is the trend line to watch on whether or not to me silver not only goes to 55 here, but potentially down to 50

calls.condition: If short-term support around 2.85 breaks, goes to 2.70.
calls.reason: Continued weakness after a big pop and retrace; short-term trend-line support.
calls.quote: If this breaks, we go right down to 270.

calls.reason: Long-term breakout, consolidation, another blast; current consolidation may precede another leg up.
calls.quote: right now, Bitcoin remains the best major asset out there in terms of charts.

calls.condition: If the major ascending trend line breaks, 'watch out below' for a significant dump.
calls.reason: Down 2-3% on earnings despite good report because it was extended; sitting on a multi-pivot ascending trend line.
calls.quote: If this line breaks, that would be a watch out below moment

calls.condition: If it drops to the double bottom around 12.60, interested in a day trade or swing long.
calls.reason: Inflation pressure on input costs weighs on the stock, but a double bottom about a dollar lower is a potential bounce spot.
calls.quote: I will be watching double bottom a dollar lower around 1260. If we get there today, I would be interested in a day trade

calls.condition: Into earnings after the bell: gap fill at 1,150 is major resistance on a rally; ascending trend line just below 1,000 is support.
calls.reason: No read on the earnings reaction; expects margin compression as new memory fabs come online, so sees it below $500 (maybe below $300) within two years.
calls.quote: I still think within two years, this will be a sub $500 stock. Sounds crazy, I know. Maybe even sub300

notes: Date inferred from transcript: host says the quarter is 'ending today' (Sep 30) and that Micron reports after the bell today; listing approx_date was 2026-10-01. Recorded after the 8:30 ET data, before the open. He mentions holding some shorts in parabolic names such as CrowdStrike (passing, not recorded). Natural gas levels quoted as '285/270' interpreted as $2.85/$2.70. Conagra level '1260' interpreted as $12.60. Long-term gold/silver bias from his combined 'gold and silver' remark.
